# Contributing to Tomoko

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Tomoko! This project is licensed under the GNU GPL v3 (see the `LICENSE` file).

## AI Policy

* Using generative AI to develop new features or making larger code changes is generally prohibited. Please refrain from contributions which are heavily depending on AI generated source code. However, you are allowed to use AI if you:
  * are aware of the project structure,
  * ensure that the generated code follows the project structure,
  * fully understand the generated code, and
  * review the generated code completely.
* Using AI to find the root cause of bugs and generating small fixes might be acceptable, but ensure the root cause is tackled.
* PRs and issues that do not follow this AI policy can be closed without further explanation.

## Issue Reporting / Feature Requests

* Make sure your issue/feature hasn't already been reported.
* Check whether the issue is still relevant in the latest version.
* Fill out the issue template completely.
* One issue per report, please.

## Code Contribution Guidelines

* Stick to the project's style conventions (checkStyle and ktlint). They run on each build.
* Follow the F-Droid inclusion policy: do not bring non-free software or closed-source libraries into the project.
* If you want to work on an existing issue, leave a comment saying so to avoid duplicate effort.
* If there is no existing issue, open a new one describing the changes you plan to introduce.
* Create PRs on a separate branch with a meaningful name (feature branch workflow).
* Test your code before submitting changes.
* Fill in the PR template — it is mandatory.
* Make sure your PR is up-to-date with the `main` branch.

## Building the App

* Clone the repository: `git clone https://github.com/fonenotalo/Tomoko.git`
* Open the folder in Android Studio.
* Build and run with the green triangle in the top bar.

## Communication

For questions and discussion, use the GitHub Discussions page linked in the README.
